svg.text: 12e Product form: a ready-made item (counted in pieces)
Route: /admin/products (popup) · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• Choosing the built-in Ready-made category swaps the recipe for Pieces on hand and Minimum (whole pieces, 0–100,000). The count is sent only when it was changed here, so a sale made while
the form was open isn't written over; the logged way to restock is Adjust stock on Raw materials › Ready-made (13b).
• A dish moved into Ready-made loses its recipe (“Saving removes this dish's recipe.”); moving an item out of Ready-made needs a recipe again. A recipe sent for a ready-made item is

g.text: Optional. Without a photo, the kiosk shows the icon. JPEG, PNG
or WebP; it's made smaller before uploading.
For one serving. Use 0 for items served as they are, like bottled drinks.
Orders use it to estimate when they'll be ready.
Ready-made items are sold as they are, so they have no recipe. Each
order takes one piece, and the item shows as sold out at 0. Restock
At or below the minimum, it counts as needing restock on the dashboard.
Quick options customers can tap, sent to the kitchen with the order.
Customers can also type a note.
No quick options: customers can only type a note.
The kiosk shows these as estimated values. Leave a value blank if it isn't known.
